name: Early 3D render
summary: A clean, glossy computer render in the look of early 3D graphics: spheres, water and glass with a sharp highlight and no wear.
how: Render one object, such as a sphere, a drop or a button, with a sharp top highlight of 40% white.
Add a faint mirrored reflection of 15% white below the object.
Set the object on a smooth sky gradient from deep blue to pale aqua, with no grain.

origin.note: The year follows the album Far Side Virtual (2011), which dates the music, not the technique. The Vaporwave article says James Ferraro named the style utopian virtual with this album and that it combined crisp, unreal early 3D graphics with vaporwave textures. It gives no date for the first render.

adoptions.via: The album Far Side Virtual and its concept of a virtual life soundtrack.
